column2: Her will and her convictions, together with the knights, went on protecting the homeland she loved for a very long time.
I think Leyla must have agonised over whether or not to go back to the Empire... But she made up her mind: she would return to the imperial capital...
Through the journey to save the world, the world she had lived in was denied to her. Even I cannot fully understand that pain and suffering.
But now she knows who was truly hurt, and she has begun working to give those people back their smiles.
When she sets aside honor and pride, and strength and kindness become one, perhaps a new image of a knight will begin to take shape within her...
Leyla Vigrid, who had fought on through the war as a knight of the Empire, returned to her homeland.
But she never again took up the knight's post that had led to such a foolish war; she began living in the imperial capital as a simple noble.
The chaos in the Empire went on for a while, but it too subsided, and peaceful days returned. Her past as a knight already seems like something from long ago.
Now she believes that uneventful, peaceful days are more precious than anything.
Rudiere Legrance: his many trials had made the boy's heart grow greatly.
He had kept asking himself what he should do, and on his journey he seems to have found the answer.
It was to walk on his own feet the path his brother had aimed for. The path of a true king was not an easy one, but he overcame it with strong conviction and will.

He never ran from the loneliness of a king or the harsh decisions of a ruler, but faced them head-on. He made painful decisions without flinching and was often misunderstood, but he always put his convictions first.
As time went by, the people of Legrance came to praise him with pride.
And as the years went on, he left his name in history as a wise king without equal:
as a man who saw the world with true eyes, as a man of courage, and as a king who knew the sufferings of his people.
Rudi seems to have resolved to carry on his brother's will.
Through the journey to save the world, I think he was always thinking about how he differed from his brother, and about his own naivety.
Perhaps he has finally realised that those differences... that brightness and kindness... are things only he has...
A hard road surely lies ahead of him. But he always thinks of his people first.
He knows better than anyone what matters to the country. I will keep praying that his heart, which treats everyone alike, will grow into a great strength...
The young prince Rudiere Legrance was deeply troubled over whether or not he should take the throne.
